actions.create_call.description: Create an outbound phone call using a Vapi assistant.
actions.create_call.props.assistantId.de: The ID of the Vapi assistant that will handle the call. Get this from your Vapi Dashboard.
actions.create_call.props.assistantOverr: Optional JSON object with assistant configuration overrides for this call (e.g. first message, model settings).
actions.create_call.props.customerNumber: The phone number to call, in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234).
actions.create_call.props.name.descripti: An optional name for this call for identification.
The ID of the phone number to make the call from. Must be a number registered in your Vapi account.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_call.description: Retrieve the details of a specific call by its ID.
actions.get_call.props.callId.descriptio: The unique identifier of the call to retrieve.
actions.update_assistant.description: Update an existing Vapi assistant configuration (name, model, first message, etc.).
actions.update_assistant.props.assistant: The unique identifier of the assistant to update.
actions.update_assistant.props.endCallMe: The message the assistant says before ending the call.
actions.update_assistant.props.firstMess: The first message the assistant will say when a call starts.
actions.update_assistant.props.instructi: Optional system prompt. Vapi does not expose a standalone top-level instructions field on UpdateAssistantDto, so if you provide this you must also provide both Model and Provider so the system prompt can be applied via model.messages without discarding your input silently.
actions.update_assistant.props.model.des: Optional model name (e.g. gpt-4o). Required if updating model config.
actions.update_assistant.props.name.desc: A new name for the assistant.
actions.update_assistant.props.overrides: Optional JSON object with additional UpdateAssistantDTO fields (e.g. model, voice, transcriber settings).
Optional model provider (e.g. openai). Required if updating model config.
auth.description:
To obtain your Vapi API key:

  1. Log in to your [Vapi Dashboard](https://dashboard.vapi.ai).
  2. Navigate to **Organization Settings** → **API Keys**.
  3. Copy your Private API key.
description: AI voice agent platform. Create outbound calls, manage assistants, and retrieve call details.
